description: This file defines the AttendanceScreen widget, which provides a user interface for selecting a date range, fetching attendance data from a provider, and displaying the attendance records in a list. It also includes UI components such as date pickers, buttons, and status chips. The file leverages Flutter widgets and external packages like intl for date formatting and provider for state management.

classes.name: AttendanceScreen
classes.description: A StatefulWidget that provides the main interface for selecting date ranges, fetching attendance data, and displaying it in a list.

classes.name: _AttendanceScreenState
classes.description: The state class for AttendanceScreen, manages UI state, handles data fetching, and rendering of the list of attendance records.

classes.name: _StatusChip
classes.description: A stateless widget that displays the attendance status as a colored chip, visualizing 'present', 'absent', or other statuses.

methods.name: _fetch
methods.description: Fetches attendance data from the provider for the selected date range and updates the UI accordingly.

methods.name: _pickRange
methods.description: Opens a date range picker dialog and updates the start and end dates based on user selection.
